name: codex-routecraft
description: Sol-led adaptive Codex orchestration with verified source control, parent verification, and persistent decision memory across sessions and computers.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive Sol-led routing plus persistent decision recall and learning.
interface.longDescription: RouteCraft keeps GPT-5.6 Sol as architect and acceptance owner, defaults to solo execution, and delegates only when a cheaper lane can safely substitute for root implementation. It routes bounded work to Luna, judgment-heavy work to Terra, parallelizes independent workstreams, and requests fresh Sol review for high-risk changes. Its Persistent Decision Layer retrieves relevant verified prior decisions, records compact reusable cases, promotes repeated candidates into validated rules, and can synchronize a separate private memory store across computers. The parent always verifies current evidence before acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-routecraft:orchestration to build this feature with adaptive routing, bounded memory recall, verification, and reusable learning.
Use RouteCraft to recall relevant prior decisions, choose the cheapest safe lane, implement this change, and verify the complete diff.
Use RouteCraft for this task; parallelize only independent work, add fresh Sol review only when risk warrants it, and preserve verified reusable decisions.
Use $codex-routecraft:memory to inspect, validate, recall, or synchronize my private RouteCraft decision store.
